tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel gyi tshe dbang bskur ba'i cho ga tshe srog rdo rjer sgrub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bkra shis dge mtshan lham mer snang ba'i sku// tshe dang ye shes dpag yas rgyal ba gang*// snang byed 'od kyi lag pas dam 'khyud pa'i// bye ru'i lhun po ltar dmar de yis srungs// gang sku rtse gcig bsam gtan pir gyi rtses// su zhig yid kyi rtsig ngos bris nas ni// gsol gdab sngags kyi rgyal po zlos pa'i lce// rnam 'gyur glog gi gar du bsgyur ba'i 'phral// skye 'gro'i 'tsho ba 'phrog byed nyi ma'i bu'i// dpung chen drung na lhags kyang bsnyengs bral bar// mi shigs rdo rje'i srog rtsa brling byed pa// thang stong rgyal po'i lugs srol deng 'dir spel// de'ang 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong pa'i lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel dag snang zab gter chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don du 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gnas khang yid du 'ong bar stegs bu'i khar ras sogs kyis bkab par me tog gi sil ma bkram pa'i dbus su nas kyi tshom bu pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du bkod pa'i steng man 'ji'i khar tshe bum rta mgos mtshan pa la mar gyis nyi zla nor bu la sogs pa rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa mthar pad 'dab kyis bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang ka ra bu ram sbyar ba dam rdzas ril bu dang tshe rdzas btab pa/ de'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das kyi gtor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma gnyis ka zlum po mtheb kyus brgyan pa/ mdun nas nyer spyod rnams sbreng tshar du bsham/ logs su sngon 'gro gtor ma zhig kyang bzhag slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod/ 'thor nas/

yungs kar rnams sta gon bya/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ma hā bhū ta lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas mgron bkug sngags de la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos/ rdo rje dril bu thogs te/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag sogs byang chub ma thob par// gegs med bar chad med mdzad cing*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces dang*/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub par 'tshal na/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig muḥzhes dang*/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas sa la reg ste/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces dang*/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil zhing suṃ bha ni dang*/ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas mtshams bcad do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la tshogs gnyis bsags pa/

bsgom bzlas bya ba/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba gsum las/ dang po la sngar nang mchod byin brlabs byas pa ma yin na/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me dang*/ thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rim̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang dharma ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes pas skyabs yul rnams kyi byin rlabs rang gzhan gyi rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde ba can nas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru a yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mī ta sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mī ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin/ rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba/ bkod pa legs pa mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag mdun tha mi dad par bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog byi ru'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dmar zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad 'phyang ba/

phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis sprad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa can/ de'i dbu'i steng du rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub dang dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis tha mi dad pa tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa can/ de'i dbu'i steng du 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang bstan 'dzin lhun grub gnyis tha mi dad pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang dang byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub gnyis tha mi dad pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po gnyis tha mi dad pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ de'i dbu'i steng du mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ de bzhin du mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog rdo rings kun spangs chen po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dbu gsum gyi steng nas rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ral gri/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ mdung thung*/ rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ sku la dur

'di la zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas thod dbyug 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa 'ga' zhig tu 'byung yang dkyus ma nyid 'thad par mngon no// khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa zhes brjod/ yang sa skya nas brgyud pa ltar na/ rang gi dbu'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa/ de'i dbu'i steng du rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub bam dpal ldan chos skyong gang rung*/ de bzhin du sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen/ rig 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags yan sngar dang 'dra bar brjod/ gang ltar yang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ tshe bcud bsdu ba ni/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba/ 'thor ba/ nyams pa mtha' dag dang*/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhi las gyur pa'i snod bcud 'khor bas bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa thams cad kyi tshe dpal bsod nams mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam pa can bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshur bsdus/

spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang phyag gi bum pa rnams su thim zhing gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi rnams khol zhing lud/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi sku las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad byang zhing dag nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ tshe rdzas rnams la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i bcud len du gyur ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ā yur sid+dhi dzaḥ mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun spangs rje// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs// dpal ldan grub rigs 'dzin pa nyi zla'i mtshan// 'chi med grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang phyug dpal// 'chi med mgon po ngag dbang chos grags la// gsol ba= /byin gyis rlobs= /sngags dang*/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang*// nam mkha' sangs rgyas mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang ngag dbang lhun grub zhabs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// gzhan yang gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin thams cad la// gsol ba= /byin gyis rlobs= /sngags dang*/ 'chi med dpal ster bkra shis lhun grub dang*// tshe dpag med mgon dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs// brgyud bka' kun 'dus drin can chos kyi rje// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ā yur sid+dhi dzaḥ

zhes gsol ba btab/ yang sa skya nas brgyud pa ltar na/ ngag dbang chos grags yan 'dra bar brjod/ de nas/ rgyal sras spyan snga kun dga' don grub dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams zhabs// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// rig 'dzin ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis mtshan// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen la// gsol ba= /byin gyis rlobs= /sngags dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bkra dpal ldan chos skyong gang rung*/ shis lhun grub zhabs// dkon mchog gsum 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// gzhan yang gdams pa mchog 'di'i byin rlabs kyi// bka' babs dngos brgyud bla ma thams cad dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la// gsol ba= /byin gyis= /sngags dang zhes gang mos brjod do// de nas sngar gyi tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa de nyid kyi ngang nas sngags de nyid ci nus su bzla'o// gzhan la dbang bskur sogs kyi dus su tshe ril dang tshe chang la'ang tshe bcud bstim pa'i dmigs pa yang yang bya/ mjug tu/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis// mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs dpung bskyed la// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ tshe dpag tu med pa 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po la thim/ zhes pa lta bu'am mi nus na/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu nas tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ tshe dpag tu med pa rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po la thim/

zhes pa gang rung gis rigs bsgres te/ de slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ de grub chen thang stong rgyal po la/ de rdo rings kun spangs chen po la/ de 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog la/ de bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po la/ de mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang la/ de mkhan chen ngag dbang chos sa skya nas brgyud pa gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar/ grags la/ de ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub la/ de nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po gnyis tha mi dad pa la/ de nam mkha' dpal bzang dang byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub gnyis tha mi dad pa la/ de 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang bstan 'dzin lhun grub gnyis tha mi dad pa la/ de rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub dang dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis tha mi dad pa la/ de dbang bskur mkhan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ de nyid kyang 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob ste/ bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /de las langs pa na gzhan la dbang bskur mi byed na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya ste/ rgyun par nyams su len pa la ni skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar gyis chog go /gsum pa ni gzhan la dbang bskur gyi dus sam bsnyen pa'i skabs gtor ma 'bul dgos tshe mnyam par gzhag pa las ldang ba na/ rang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bye ba'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur ces brjod la/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes pa nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar sngar bzhin brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/

mdun bskyed la mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa gsum mam lngas phul nas/ phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul ba dang bstod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā kī ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spyan drangs nas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs spyi ltar ram/ mi nus na/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes nas// yid la 'dod pa kun sgrubs shig /ces pas phrin las bcol lo// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad do// 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i tshe dbang zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa rnams gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal rjes su 'tsham pa'i dam pa chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar bsam gyis mi khyab par phye bar mdzad pa rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na/

theg pa chung ngu dang chen po gnyis las/ 'dir khyad chos bdun gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen yin/ de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su gnas pa las/ 'dir khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin/ sngags kyi theg pa rnams su'ang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sgrub pa'i thabs dpag tu med pa gsungs pa las/ 'di rgyas par byed pa'i nang tshan tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed pa ste/ de la'ang bka' dang gter byon gyi lugs srol du ma yod pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas las dngos su gsan pa'i dag snang lugs dang*/ bsam yas mchims phu'i gsang phug nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter dang yang chu bo gnyis 'dres su gyur pa'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang zab mo ste/ de'ang rgyal ba yongs kyi phrin las pa chen po grub chen thang stong rgyal po nyid ni/ slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan kun gsal me long las/ zhi ba thugs rje chen po dang : drag po khro rgyal rta mgrin gnyis: dbyer med gcig tu sprul pa las: sku yi cha lugs zhi ma khro: mdog smug dri zhim sme bas brgyan: ngang rgyud dal zhing rig rtsal che: ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs skyong*/ nang rtags ya mtshan ston pa 'byung : zhes dang*/ slob dpon rang gi thugs sprul yin pa'ang*/ 'ol ba zhes bya'i shar mdun du: brtson 'grus zhes bya'i ming can 'byung : de ni nga yis thugs sprul yin: zhes sogs kyis lung bstan pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lngas mtshan re re phul ba'i/ dang po ni/ khyab gdal chen po'i thang chen na// stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs// de phyir thang stong rgyal po thogs// zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid dang*/

slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyis dag pa'i snang ngor so sor dbyer med kyang*/ gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor slob dpon chen po dang lan mang du zhal mjal/ khyad par zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su sku dngos su byon nas/ slob dpon chen po he ru ka'i chas su zhugs nas sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye zhing dbang bskur/ gzhan yang gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la slob dpon chen pos zhu ba po'i tshul bzung ste bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud la sogs pa gsan nas/ slar yang slob dpon chen pos grub chen nyid bod yul du byon na 'gro don che bar lung bstan pa ni/ chos bka' gter lnga bod na yod: gdul bya rnam dag bod du 'ong : zhes dang*/ sa 'brug dbyar zla dang po'i tshes bcu la: sa yi me btsa' rten 'brel bsgrig dgos yod: 'gyangs na chu shor zin pa'i rag dang 'dra: sngas na ri dwags ma chud rgya dang 'dra: rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu phan sems can: slar yang bod yul kha ba can du bzhud: ces gsungs pa la brten nas grub chen nyid bod yul du byon nas rten gsum bzhengs pa dang*/ lcags zam 'dzugs pa la sogs pa mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas par gyur pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga'/ grub chen de nyid nye brgyud shin tu zab pa'i tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa 'di la brten nas dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga bzhugs so// grub chen gyi dngos slob chos rje mang yul ba 'phags pa blo gros kyis dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhugs/ khams rdo gog dgon dang nye ba'i char bzhugs pa'i grub chen gyi dngos slob yin pa zhig gis lo brgya dang sum cu bzhugs/ tshom sgang pa'i bla ma zhig gis lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs/ yang khams na grub chen gyi dngos slob cig gis lo brgya phrag kha yar brgal bar bzhugs pa dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus yod pa sogs grub chen nyid sku tshe la mnga' brnyes pa'i rten 'brel gyis slob ma'ang sku tshe la dbang 'byor ba mang po byung ba'i byin rlabs can gyi tshe dbang zab mo de sgrub pa la/

slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun lhan cig tu bsgrubs nas tshe 'gugs kyi bzlas pa bya ba/ slar bdag mdun so sor phye nas mdun bskyed la mchod gtor 'bul ba/ mkha' 'gro spyi la gtor ma 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i dgos pa rnams legs par grub nas/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa tha mi dad pa la tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ces pa nas gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ des rgyud dag par byas nas/ khyed rnams la tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur zhing 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba'i slad du/ slob dpon rang nyid skad cig tsam gyis khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar ba/ dbu gsum gyi steng nas rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ral gri/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ mdung thung*/ rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rang 'dra'i khro chung tshon gang bas gtams pa/

zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs brgyad klu brgyad kyi steng na brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur nas/ de'i gnas gsum dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi bar dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams kyis dbang dang dngos grub len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛta sogs brjod pa dang thun brdog cing rol mo bya/ slar yang khyed rnams kyi 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur par mos la/ de la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas brtan par bya ba rnams ni sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rnams kyi sku la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba rgyu dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin gdos bcas kyi lus sbyangs te 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams gnas pa'i zhing 'di sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin sogs nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer gyur par mos/ de ltar khyed rnams tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i dbu'i steng du da ltar dbang bskur mkhan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku'i rnam pa can dang*/

de'i dbu'i steng du rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub dang dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis tha mi dad pa tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa can zhes pa nas snang ba mtha' yas rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ de rnams la slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang*/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur par mos pa mdzod/ slar

slob ma lha bskyed skabs 'dir ye shes dbab pa spyan snga ba sogs kyi yig char mi 'byung yang phyis kyi yi ge 'ga' zhig tu byung ba ltar rgyas pa'i yan lag tu byas pa yin pas gong bdag mdun sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin ma byas kyang chad skyon mi 'byung ngo*// yang spyi bo'i lha tshogs de rnams kyi thugs ka dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka dang*/ bde ba can dang*/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang*/ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas rnams na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sku'i rnam pa grangs med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags kyi mthar a wa sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes btags pa brjod pas bstim/ de ni gzhi dgod pa yin/ dngos gzhi tshe bcud sdud pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi lha tshogs rnams dang slob dpon la mos gus drag tu byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab pas/ de dag na gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad ma rungs pa rnams kyis khyed rnams kyi bla tshe brkus pa/ khyer ba/ yar ba/ 'thor ba/ nyams pa mtha' dag dang*/ ban bon mthu chen rnams kyis rdzas dang sngags dang bsam gtan gyi sbyor bas tshe srog 'phrog pa thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bkug ste khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi lha tshogs rnams dang phyag gi bum pa rnams kyi nang du zhugs/

slar yang 'od zer 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ gser gyi ri bdun/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ khor yug lcags kyi ri bo la sogs pa na gnas pa'i 'byung ba sa'i bcud sra zhing 'thas pa thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po/ rol pa'i chu gter la sogs pa'i rgya mtsho dang*/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi/ 'bab chu/ chu mig lteng ka la sogs pa 'byung ba chu'i bcud mnyen lcug 'khril ldem byed pa'i nus pa thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi me'i dkyil 'khor/ rta gdong gi me/ byin za'i me/ brdabs pa dang gtsubs pa'i me/ nyi ma nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs pa me'i bcud bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa'i nus pa thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'degs byed kyi rlung*/ sdud byed kyi rlung*/ 'dzin byed kyi rlung*/ las kyi rlung ye shes kyi rlung la sogs pa yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi bcud yang rtsal stobs dang ldan pa bskyed pa'i nus pa dang bcas pa thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bsdus nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi lha tshogs sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi 'gro ba thams cad la phog pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ khams kyi rgyal phran la sogs pa lha mi bsod nams dang ldan pa rnams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par bsdus nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ yang 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ nub phyogs bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dang*/

steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dang*/ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi zhal yas na bzhugs pa'i bla ma zhi khro'i tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi lha tshogs rnams dang de dag gi phyag gi bum pa rnams su thim zhing gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi rnams khol zhing lud/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi sku las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad byang zhing dag nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ mtshams su dril bu gsil ba dang bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong zhes pa nas/ byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol zhes pa'i bar gyi gsol 'debs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ slar yang tshe'i bcud len gyi rang bzhin gyis tshe ril sbyin pa ni/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar gyis// 'di zos bcom ldan tshe dpag med// zhal mthong 'gyur bar gdon mi za// zhes sngags dang bcas pas byin/ yang tshe'i bcud len gyi bdud rtsi sbyin pa ni/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes sngags dang bcas pas byin/ dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja bzang zhal spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog

/ces pas shis pa brjod do// gal te tshe bcud bsdu ba'i brda sprod rgyas pa de bzhin brjod mi nus pa dag gis/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang slob dpon la mos gus byas pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba 'thor ba nyams pa mtha' dag dang*/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi zhes sogs nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar rang dang khyed rnams zhes pa'i khyad par bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs gong bdag mdun sgrub pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin brjod pas btub ste/ spyan snga ba sogs sngar gyi yig cha khungs ldan rnams su'ang de bzhin 'byung ba dang*/ phyag len kyang de ltar mdzad pa shas che zhing*/ de'i steng gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod pas kyang shin tu legs pa zhig 'byung ngo*// skabs 'dir tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs byed na/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba sogs gong bdag mdun sgrub pa'i skabs ltar brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas sogs nas/ thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes gsol 'debs bsdus pa sngags dang bcas te tshe bum gyis dbang bskur/ bkra shis tshe brtan sogs kyi tshe ril dang*/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal sogs sngags dang bcas pas tshe chang byin/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs kyis shis pa brjod de/ de lta bu'i sgo nas grangs bzung zhing bsags te thams cad kyi mtha' ma la gsol 'debs rgyas par brjod pas don 'grub bo// de dag gang ltar yang*/

de nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis gsol ba gdab/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas tshe dpag med la thim zhes pa nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ rtsa khams thams cad la khyab ces sogs nas/ de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ slar yang de nyid brtan pa'i slad du/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs lhan cig pas me tog gi char dbab cing bkra shis kyi cho ga byas par mos pa mdzod/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs dang*/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod do// de ni rgyal bar byed pa'i shis pa brjod pa ste/ de rnams kyis tshe dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ tshe dbang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dbul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs dang*/ de rnams kyis grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs kyis dge ba byang chub tu bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs/

phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab rnams byas nas/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya sogs pad+ma bzhi sbyor ram rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa mthol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥmakha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ tshe dpag med kyi sku rten yod pa'am da dung tshe dbang dgos pa yod na tshe bum la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya/ de lta ma yin na mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag med rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang*/ dpon slob mi 'bral zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod do// smras pa/ ma dros bsti gnas las byung chu klung che// srid pa ji srid 'bab par rgyun ring mas// brgyud ldan gdams pa zab mos skyes bu'i srog /'chi med bskal pa'i srid du bsring bar mtshon// rnam bkra dbang po'i gzhu bzhin ltar snang gi /mdzes chos sna tshogs bsres pa'i skyon zlos kyis// ches zab brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yal dogs nas// snga ma'i yi ge sor bzhag 'di ngas brtsams// legs byas 'jug pa bcu pas bdag sogs 'gro// gnas skabs lnga pa'i dngangs skrag stobs ldan dpung*// bskal pa'i mthar brgal rkang 'og bcings nas ni// gnas lugs 'chi med mgon po'i zhal mthong shog /ces grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel gyi tshe dbang bskur ba'i cho ga tshe srog rdo rjer sgrub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan dang lhun grub phun tshogs zung gis bskul ngor/ rje btsun spyan snga bas mdzad pa'i yi ge la gzhir byas/ lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa lcags zam pa dang*/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i tho zur mchis pa rnams las legs cha cung zad res brgyan te/

kun mkhyen gnyis pa e waṃ pa brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bos pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed kyi lo'i rgyu skar bu mo khrums stod kyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa la/ dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyis bkra shis par bsgrubs pa'i nyin sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba dang nye ba'i gnod sbyin phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi sarba yuḥpuṇ+ya dz+nyā nāṃ pi stā ra bha wa tu// // ༄༅// grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi rgyun 'khyer ring 'tsho tshe'i zil mngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ badz+rā yuḥsid+dhiḥpra yats+tshan+tu/ dge mtshan 'bar ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku// bsgom zhing bzlas pas bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga// lhang nger ldir ba don ldan thang stong pa'i// lugs srol 'chi med sgrub pa'i rgyun 'khyer 'dri// de'ang grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi gdams pa rgyun 'khyer du nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro spyi ltar ram/ yang na ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba ci nus kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la zhugs par bsam/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub thabs zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mī ta sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mī ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin/ rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba/ bkod pa legs pa mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog bye ru'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dmar zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcing zhing lhag ma cung zad 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/

rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dbu yi steng du skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de'i dbu'i steng nas yar rim bzhin rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'o zhes sam/ de ltar mi nus na/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar 'dra ba la de'i dbu'i steng du skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'o zhes brjod cing gsal btab/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur zhes brjod/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

gzhan yod pa'i tshe/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi zhes gdags/ bdag gi bla tshe yar ba/ 'thor ba/ nyams pa mtha' dag dang*/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhi las gyur pa'i snod bcud 'khor bas bsdus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa thams cad kyi tshe dpal bsod nams mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshur bsdus/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang phyag gi bum pa rnams su thim zhing gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi rnams khol zhing lud/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad byang zhing dag nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun spangs rje// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs// dpal ldan grub rigs 'dzin pa nyi zla'i mtshan// 'chi med grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang phyug dpal// 'chi med mgon po ngag dbang chos grags la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang*// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bkra shis lhun gyis grub// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥzhes pas gsol ba btab/

de nas tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin yang yang gsal 'debs kyin/ sngags de nyid brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs ci nus su bzlas/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni bum phrag bcu sogs gsungs kyang tshe sgrub la rtags dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gtso che bar gsungs/ thun bsdu ba na mos gu drag pos/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis// mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs dpung bskyed la// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams rim bzhin 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /'di la bsnyen pa byed pas ni gong du mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ 'dir gtor ma 'bul ba rnams ni gong gi dbang chog skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// gsum pa ni/ thun las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing sogs dang*/ gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam ci rigs pa brjod do// smras pa/ rig byed 'byin pa'i bkas phab lha yi chu// bskal bar 'bab kyang mthas gtugs dben pa 'dis// zab mo'i bsgom bzlas kyis bsgrubs rnal 'byor pa'i// tshe srog mi shigs bskal par gnas par mtshon// rnam dkar dge ba'i mtshar sdug sgyu rtsal gyis// 'khor 'das tshe dpal dngos grub mdza' na mo// dal rten khang bur khugs pa'i sems can rnams// bde legs 'dod pa dgu la rtsen gyur cig

/ces grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi rgyun 'khyer ring 'tsho tshe'i zil mngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po'i sku mdun gyi smyug 'dzin dbang po gu ru'i mtshan can gyi gsung gis bskul dor/ rje btsun kun dga' don grub kyis mdzad pa sogs lugs 'dir tshad mar 'os pa rnams kyi gsung gi legs chas kyang cung zad brgyan te nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i me glang gi lo'i snron zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa lhag pa lag sor lhan cig 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// byang gter lugs kyi tshe dpag med nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mkha' khyab 'gyur med chos sku snang mtha' yas// dge mtshan lhun grub longs sku bde ldan mgon// 'gro 'dul brdzus skyes sprul sku mtsho skyes zhabs// sku gsum gcig gyur bla ma gtsug na rgyal// 'chi med ring 'tsho gdams pa'i bcud len sgo// 'byed pa'i byed po gter chen rgod ldem pas// mtho ris mgon po'i skal bzang zil mngar la// rnam mkhyen sgrub sems dben pa'i dma' 'bebs byas// yongs 'dzin rnam bzhi'i thugs rje dar bab ma'i// 'chad tshul mkhas pa'i 'gram chang gis btab pas// tshul 'dir rnam par dpyod pa'i ba ku la// lag len dri bral 'dab ma brgya phrag grol// de'ang 'dir rgyal kun spyi gzugs slob dpon chen po pad+ma ka ra'i zhal lung gis mngon par bsngags pa'i gter chen dngos grub rgyal mtshan nam rig 'dzin rgod ldem can nas nye bar brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub lcags sdong mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la gsum ste/

sbyor ba yo byad bsham pa/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i thabs/ byin rlabs dbang gi cho ga'o// dang po sbyor ba yod byad bsham pa ni/ gzhung las/ yar ngo dus dang gza' skar bzang po la// sa gtsang bkra shis dben pa'i gnas btsal te// 'bru spos rat+na sman dang snying po lnga// rgyun chad med pa'i chu yis bum pa bkang*// gtsang ma'i gos dkris dpag bsam sdong pos brgyan// zhes 'byung ba ltar stegs bu'i khar maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad sngon po'am ras la bris pas kyang rung ste/ de'i steng man 'ji'i khar rin po che'i bum pa chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang bar bum rdzas nyer lnga dang*/ bsgrubs pa'i tshe rdzas/ chos sman bzang po'i bcud dang ldan pa la mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan sku rten can/ phyag len 'ga' zhig tu zan las byas pa'i gtor ma smad zlum po stod tshe bum dam gzugs 'dra ba la rtse rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ mthar tshe ril gyis bskor bar byed pa yang yod do// g.yas su tshe rdzas bsres pa'i tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ tshe mda' rgod sgro mar dar sna tshogs dang tshe g.yu dang me long gis brgyan pa/ de mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod/ zlum gtor gnyis dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod me tog li khri sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i thabs la/ thog mar nang mchod byin rlabs sngar byas pa yin na mi dgos kyang*/ min na 'og gi gtor ma ltar byin brlabs byas la/ mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+māḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/

mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang dhar+m+ma ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum// thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol// mnyam nyid rang bzhin dgongs pa can// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// ye shes rang snang thugs rje can// yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi// smon lam dbang gis 'gro don mdzad// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// ma chags gsung gis 'gro don mdzad// dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// ma nor lam la 'dren mdzad pa// dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi// rang byung chen po sprul pa'i sku// pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid la 'dud// legs nyes stang 'dzin dngos grub ster// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol// zhes lan gsum la sogs pa ci rig par brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag gis 'gro ba'i don bya'i phyir// tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas// brgyad khri'i bar du tshe srog ni// sra zhing brtan par byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed do// lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i cha byad chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa 'dzin pa/

sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ phrag pa g.yas g.yon du nyi zla 'char ba/ dwangs ma 'od lnga'i rgyab yol can/ khong pa'i nang bag chags kyi snyigs ma gdos bcas thams cad dag nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar gsal bas khengs pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug nas gsang gnas bar du lcags kyi srog rtsa smyug sdong gi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu dwangs gsal 'od lngar 'bar ba/ srog rtsa'i phyi nang thams cad sngags kyi yig 'bru dung mdog zil pa chags pa lta bus gtams pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra'i tshe dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ de'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang nas tshe bcud bdud rtsi lud/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas babs te/ dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus thams cad dang khyad par srog rtsa'i sbug thams cad mer gyis gang*/ lha'i sku dang srog rtsa'i sngags 'bru bdud rtsi rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas gsal zhing 'tsher ba'i gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams/ slar yang 'di skad brjod cing bsam ste/ lha dang sngags kyi 'od zer ni// lcags kyu lta bus 'jig rten khyab// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi// thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus// phyogs skyong mkha' 'gro sde brgyad kyi// rdzu 'phrul tshe bkrag gzi mdangs phrogs// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang*// gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho dang*// rtsi shing nags tshal rin chen tshogs// 'byung ba lnga yi dwangs pa bsdus// lha klu mi yi dbang thang dang*// bsod nams tshe yi dngos grub bsdus// bdud rtsi'i 'od zer char ltar babs// thams cad ma lus bdag la thim// 'chi med tshe yi dngos gru thob// stong gsal 'od kyi gong bur gyur// zhes brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na mo bha ga wa te/

a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bh+rūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus su bzlas mthar mdun gyi tshe dpag med la mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i sku// mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol// 'byung ba 'dus pa gsar 'tsher brtan pa'i sku// thun mong tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// 'khor lo brgyud de bdag gi snying gar thim// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur// ā yur+dz+nyā na bin+dhu bh+rūm̐/ nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi a bh+rūm̐/ zhes brjod pas tshe dpag med rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang dang ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med par 'dres par bsams la/ lha'i sku yang gshis lugs la dpyad pa'i blo ngor yod med gang du'ang ma grub pa'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /na mo bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig /'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig /tshe yongs su rgyas par gyur cig /tshe yongs su 'phel bar gyur cig /tshe'i bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig /tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus 'dis kyang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byed par gyur cig mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/

rgyun gyi nyams len la skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar nyams su bstar zhing tho rengs sngags brgya re dang*/ 'chi ltas byung ba na stong rtsa re bzlas pas dus min 'chi ba bzlog par bshad do// 'di'i bsnyen pa byed na rwa ba bzhi po gang rung gi yar tshes gza' skar bzang po 'dzom pa'i tho rengs shig nas mgo brtsam te kha shar du phyogs pas bsgom bzlas la 'bad pa'i sngags bzhi 'bum la sogs pa bsags na gzhung nas bstan pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ngo*// gsum pa byin rlabs dbang gi cho ga la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba la mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang ba'i dbus su

'di ni bum pa dngos su yod pa'i tshe de'i nang du lha bskyed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ tshe bum bcos ma'i tshe de nyid stong pa'i ngang las lha'i sku bskyed pa'i lugs so sor shes dgos so// paṃ las lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sogs nas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dung mdog zil pa chags pa lta bus gtams pa zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin gsal btab nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra'i tshe dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ de'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang nas tshe bcud bdud rtsi lud/ lha'i spyi gtsug nas babs te dbang bskur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed lha la gnyis su med par thim/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// ces sogs kyis bstod/ lha dang sngags kyi 'od zer ni zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi'i 'od zer char ltar babs// bum pa tshe rdzas bcas la thim// 'chi med tshe yi bcud len gyur// zhes brjod cing bsams la gzungs brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzlas/ slar yang tshe mda' g.yab cing*/ tshe 'gugs kyis bstim pa ni/ hūm̐ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe dang g.yang spel cig /steng 'og phyogs bcu'i snod kyi 'jig rten la// 'bros dang 'khyams dang yar ba'i tshe khug cig /stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis// brkus dang 'phrog dang bzhams pa'i tshe khug cig /'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrug pa'i las sbyor gyis// nyams dang zad dang 'thor ba'i tshe sos shig

/yad kyis dngangs dang had kyis brgyal ba dang*// 'ud kyis 'drogs pa'i tshe dang g.yang sos shig /tshe khug g.yang skyob dngos grub bdag la stsol// 'byung ba 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud thim// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol// zhes tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las bskul lo// gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me dang thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ ye shes lnga rnams gnas pa/ mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu ba'i rnam pa/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das la/ gzungs ring la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam lngas dbul/ mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod bstod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa mkha' 'gro sde brgyad spyi la byin rlabs dran par byas te/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos/ phyi mchod nang mchod phul la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las gzhol ba spyi ltar byas/ gtor ma gsum pa gzhi bdag la 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron bkug sngags de la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gzhi bdag gnas srung gter gyi bdag

/rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu chen ldan// 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag sogs byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med mdzad cing*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub par 'tshal na/ 'jig rten skyong ba khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu grub pa dang*/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la spyir rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa la brten nas gzhan don du bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub tu yod pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin/ de lta bu'i skabs 'dir byang chub sgrub pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten gegs med ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi'i gar la rta dang mtshungs// skyes bu'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog 'gyu dang*// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye 'gro'i tshe srog ring por mi gnas par gsungs par ma zad/ bye brag tu snyigs ma'i dus 'dir tshe'i snyigs mar gyur pas dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i rkyen dang bar chad kyi rnam pa mang ste/

klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang po ste// gson pa'i tshe ni cung zad cig /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i bar chad kyi rkyen bsal nas skyes bu'i tshe bsring ba'i thabs kyang*/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ 'chi ltas sna tshogs shes byas la// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid la'ang*// bslu ba'i thabs ni shes par bya// lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyi nang gi yin// nor bu sngags sman phyi yis te// rnal 'byor nus pas nang yin no// zhes phyi dang nang gi dbye bas mang du 'gyur ba las mchog tu gyur pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gdams ngag dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyi zhal lung rdzas dang sngags dang bsam gtan gyi sgo nas tshe bsgrub pa'i cho ga mang du yod pa las/ 'dir au rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha was/ lha sras zhus lan skabs las/ dus ngan tha ma mthar thug sleb ka ru// ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhig gi smon lam gyis// nga yi gter 'don lha sras gdung brgyud skyob// ces sogs kyis gsal bar lung bstan pa'i gter chen chos kyi rgyal po dngos grub rgyal mtshan nam/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can zhes yongs su grags pas/ byang phyogs brag ri dug sbrul spungs pa 'dra ba'i rked pa nas mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i gter rnams bzhes pa'i ya gyal/ lho gser mdzod ser po'i chos sde'i bye brag drag po thugs sgrub rnam pa gsum gyi nang tshan nyi shu rtsa lnga las bcu dgu pa/ rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring ba'i phyir// tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po yod// ces gsungs pa'ang phyi sgrub rin chen bum pa/ nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po/ gsang sgrub hrīḥgacig ma/ yang gsang nam mkha'i rdo rje dang bzhi yod pa las/ 'dir nang ltar sgrub pa ste/ de'ang*/ tshe zad mtha' la thug gyur kyang*// 'di bsgrubs lo brgya nges par thub// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin ngas// 'di yi yon tan brjod mi lang*// zhes phan yon can gyi dbang bskur ba de sgrub pa la/

slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa rnams sngon du song*/ khyed rnams ngo skal du gyur pa slob dpon tshe dpag tu med pa dang tha mi dad pa la tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar phul nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ chos sku longs sku sogs gong ltar ram/ yang na/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// rang snang ye shes shar ba'i sku// yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi// dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// zhes pas skyabs su song nas/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis tshe lo dpag tu med par byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad cing sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub thabs zab mo nyams su blang snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ bdag gis 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir sogs sam/ yang na/ sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags// 'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir// gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod// don dam spros bral byang chub sems// rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom// zhes pa gang rung gis rjes zlos lan gsum gyis sems bskyed pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/

de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas snang srid gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ khyed rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sogs nas dung mdog zil pa chags pa lta bus gtams pa zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin gsal btab/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka dang bde ba can nas bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi mthar a we sha ya a ā zhes btags pa bzla zhing spos rol bya/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas bstim pas lus thams cad gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod ces dang tshe mda' thogs te/ hūm̐ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// 'byung ba lnga la sogs kyis tshe 'gugs bya/ de nas tshe bum spyi bor bzhag la dmigs pa ni/ tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ mdun bskyed sngags kyi 'od zer sogs nas/ thams cad ma lus bu la thim// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob// stong gsal 'od kyi gong bur bsgoms// zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ hūm̐ skye 'chi gnyis med bde ba chen po'i sku// mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub bu la stsol// 'byung lnga 'dus pa gsal 'tsher brtan pa'i sku// thun mong tshe yi dngos grub bu la stsol// zhes dang*/

gzungs ring sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing dbang bskur ba ni sku'i dbang*/ tshe 'gugs byed pa'am mi byed kyang*/ gzungs sngags brjod cing bum pa mgrin par bzhag pa gsung gi dbang*/ hūm̐ skye 'chi gnyis med nas bu la stsol zhes dang*/ gzungs sngags brjod cing bum pa snying gar bzhag pa thugs kyi dbang ngo*// de gsum ga la bum pa'i chu yod pa'i skabs sbyin no// de nas mdun bskyed lha'i dbu gtsug tu bla ma brgyud pa rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la mos gus bskyed mdzod/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med mgon tsaṇ+ḍa li// pad+ma rgyal po 'tsho rgyal rgod ldem pa// sangs rgyas byams bzang se ston nyi bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// mgon bzang rin chen rgyal mtshan mgon po zla// chos kyi rgyal mtshan bkra shis stobs rgyal dang*// rig 'dzin ngag dbang chos dbyings rang grol la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zil gnon bzhad pa pad+ma phrin las dang*// rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub gter yang na pad+ma phrin las nas/ bdag gling*// rin chen rnam rgyal theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa// kun bzang rnam rgyal rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes gter gzhung gtsor 'don gyi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ yang na/ rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin rgod ldem byams pa bshes gnyen zhabs// sangs rgyas dpal bzang chos rgyal bsod nams la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// chos skyong bsod nams tshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bsod nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos grags zhabs// bsod nams rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// bkras lhun dpal chos gnyis kas rjes bzung ba// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes ngag dbang chos grags pa'i yi ge'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ste de gnyis gang la mos ltar gsol ba btab pas/

de rnams kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas dbang bskur ba'i tshul gyis bla ma rnams yas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i lha la thim/ de'ang khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas sib kyis thim par mos pa gyis zhes dang*/ hrīḥbacom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// 'khor lo brgyud de bu yi snying gar thim// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog /ces bum pa spyi bor bzhag la bum chu sbyin/ gzungs sngags brjod cing tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ na mo slob bu 'di rnams kyi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig ces sogs nas mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis smon lam gdab/ de nas slob ma'i dpral bar li khri'i thig le bkod la/ dpral bar rta mgrin dmar po be con dang sdigs mdzub can gyis phyi'i rtsa sgo bsrung bar bsams la/ tsit+ta gsang ba'i sgo srung ni// dbang gi rgyal po rta mgrin gyis// tshe srog bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir// 'chi bdag bdud kyi sgo chod la// tshe bdag chen por bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje lag tu thogs te/ dang po rtse gcig sems kyi rgya// gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya// drug pa rta mgrin dbang gi rgya// bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya// rgya bdun rim gyis btab pa las// su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐// zhes brjod cing snying ga mgo bo/ rgyab/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis rnams su rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la sgo rnams bsrung ngo*// slar yang stong nyid sba bas bsrung phyir khyed rnams lha'i gsal snang 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su bsdus nas mnyam par 'jog pa zhu zhes dang*/

rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ a chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na// gnod byed bgegs kyis lta ci smos// de phyir khyed kyi tshe sbas so// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes rgyas gdab pa dang bcas pa ni tshe dbang gi dngos gzhi ste/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs rnams spyi ltar bya'o// 'di la tshe dbang brgya rtsa la sogs pa gsog par 'dod na/ thog mar thugs kyi dbang yan chad tshar gcig song ba'i rjes su dmigs pa'i brda sprod/ mdun bskyed sngags kyi 'od zer nas/ stong gsal 'od kyi gong bur bsgom// zhes pa'i bar ram/ bsdu na/ mdun bskyed tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas rdo rje tshe'i dbang bskur bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod ces pa tsam dang*/ hūm̐ skye 'chi gnyis med nas/ thun mong tshe yi dngos grub bu la stsol// zhes dang*/ gzungs sngags brjod cing tshe bum mgo bor bzhag ste dbang bskur/ tshe ril dang tshe chang yang sngags de nyid kyis sbyin la grangs bzung*/ grangs ci tsam 'dod pa song ba'i mtshams nas bla ma tho brtsegs kyi dbang dang bum lha bstim pa sogs bya/ slob ma mang po yod pa'i tshe bum pa'i lha las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa chad de bstim pa'i dmigs pa byas pas grub bo// cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra bar bya ste/ 'on kyang bum pa'i lha bstim tshar ba'i lugs kyis mchod bstod ma byas kyang chog par gsung mod/ gang zag gi blo la bde ched mdun bskyed kyi lha sngar yod gsal gdab pa'i tshul gyis dran pa la/ mchod bstod gsol gdab nongs pa bzod par gsol ba'i mthar/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag tu med pa rang la bstim pa rnams byas kyang 'gal ba yod pa mi sems te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thugs rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis gshegs bzhugs kyi rnam pa ci yang ston pa la mtha' gcig 'chel du ma mchis te/ rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gags pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gang ltar yang bdag bskyed mjug sdud bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ bslu med sngags kyi rgyal pos btab tsam nas// 'tsho bas btang nye skyes bu'i srog gi rtsa// brgya phrag bgrang gzhir brling ldan lcags kyi khams// bskrun pa chos 'di'i zab khyad yin snyam bgyid// grub dbang zhal lung byin rlabs drod po che// 'khrugs par bzhugs tshul cho ga'i lam bstar bas// sngon rabs gza' skar 'khrugs bsdebs rnga bong gi /nga rgyal gnam ru khengs pa rang dbang gug /dkar dkar legs byas bkra shis 'khyil pa'i dbyangs// lhang lhang ldir ba'i khor yug lus can rnams// 'jigs 'jigs dus min 'chi ba'i rims med par// brel brel skyid pa'i glu gar rtsen gyur cig /ces byang gter lugs kyi tshe dpag med nang sgrub lcags kyi sdong po'i sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po/ rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa rnams kyi yig cha so sor brten pa'i dbang rgyun bcas legs par thob pa rgyun mi nub pa'i ched du gter gzhung gi dgongs pa zhib dpyad kyis mi 'gal bar nyams su blang bde bar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i myos ldan zhes bya ba'i gnam lo'i snron zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa dge legs rab tu 'phel bar gyur cig/
